source: founder design iterations and approved plan
observation: Separating the stable context switches from a large domain-owned navigator produced the first structure the founder approved; it also created clean ownership boundaries for five follow-up packages.
evidence: Founder approved iteration 4 after explicitly defining reset, scan, attention and task-specific access jobs.

observation: Driving the real 390px drawer caught an interaction failure that DOM tests did not: the visible drawer lived under an inert root and its scrim painted above it. Portalling the drawer beside the root made the actual navigation path work.
evidence: Live deep Work route opened Menu and navigated to Conversations after the portal/layer correction; implementation screenshots retained under evidence/implementation.

observation: Three delegated proposal rounds produced many polished renders but repeatedly missed the founder's structural intent; the useful direction emerged only after pausing delegation and reasoning together about navigation jobs and space allocation.
evidence: Founder rejected v1, v2 and v3, then approved the directly discussed domain-switcher plus navigator-outlet structure.

observation: Using one Tailwind breakpoint for both structural mode and control compaction created a 768px mode mismatch and sub-44px targets through 1024px; the independent review caught it before ship.
evidence: Review blocker resolved by min-[769px] structural variants, min-[1025px] compaction variants and a focused regression assertion.

observation: Phases run: one combined refine/design/architecture round reopened for four visual iterations, one same-agent red/green build, one fresh-agent review round, one builder resolution pass, retro and ship. Most rework was design exploration and browser-evidence plumbing; implementation itself remained a focused shell change.
evidence: Four concept iterations; 89 focused tests; one review round with five resolved blocking groups; full repository verification green.
